uncited: **Inputs:** Original image data, volumetric representation data.
**Outputs:** Compressed bitstream containing volume data and residual data.
The bitstream is structured to support scalability.
It contains the volume data (object coding) and the residual data.
**Volume Reconstruction (Unquantized):** Construct the reconstructed image directly from the volume data without applying quantization or entropy coding to the volume coefficients themselves.
**Encoding:** Encode the residuals alongside the volume data.
**Decoding:** At the decoder, select the quality of the volume first.
*   **Time Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
